{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2016–17 |team=Texas Longhorns |image=Texas Longhorns logo.svg |conference=Big 12 Conference |short_conf= Big 12 |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=11–22 |conf_record=4–14 |head_coach=[[Shaka Smart]] |hc_year=2nd |asst_coach1=David Cason |asst_coach2=[[Darrin Horn]] |asst_coach3=[[Jai Lucas]] |stadium=[[Frank Erwin Center]] |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2016–17 Big 12 men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by second-year head coach [[Shaka Smart]] and played their home games at the [[Frank Erwin Center]] in [[Austin, Texas]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]].{{cite web|url=http://www.texassports.com/index.aspx?path=mbball|title=MEN'S BASKETBALL|work=TexasSports.com|accessdate=January 2, 2017}}{{cite web|url=http://texassports_com.s3.amazonaws.com/documents/2015/11/18/mbb_factbook_2015_16.pdf|title=2015-16 Texas Basketball Fact Book|work=TexasSports.com|accessdate=January 2, 2017|archive-date=July 22, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160722163145/http://texassports_com.s3.amazonaws.com/documents/2015/11/18/mbb_factbook_2015_16.pdf|url-status=dead}} They finished the season 11–22, 4–14 in [[2016–17 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in last place. They defeated [[2016–17 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]] in the first round of the [[2017 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals, where they lost to [[2016–17 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|West Virginia]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Longhorns]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 20–13, 11–7 in [[2015–16 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in fourth place in the conference. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2015–16 Baylor Bears basketball team|Baylor]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they lost in the first round to [[2015–16 Northern Iowa Panthers men's basketball team|Northern Iowa]] on a buzzer beater. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
